inventory.qualification_status: Worklist only. Runtime-generated actions, conditional states and permission behavior still require rendered and API qualification.

provenance: Direct ChatGPT authorship and review; no independent external audit, Fabric job, or Codash binding asserted.
owner_constraints: Preserve every existing feature and all existing operator data. Addition and tuning are approved; deletion or retirement is not.

acceptance_dimensions.rule: Applicable dimensions require source-bound evidence or an explicit reviewed non-applicability rationale; inventory presence and prior-source evidence are not acceptance.
